# Synthetic failure capture after the audit/06 R3 withdrawal/pruning fix for the opt-in two_stage_v3 layout

Source commit 5de78806a40b05aacc695e78c1be37a2c7156bbf (a later-turn repair-history entry now treats every id in addedClaimIds as an information claim of its update even after the claim was withdrawn or pruned, and resolves withdrawn claims still recorded in the graph). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the replaced failure-path-two-stage-v3-c806f60 capture (never adopted outside this branch, removed), records differ only at 21 leaves: 15 run IDs, 5 instruction-source hash leaves (`v2/jev-turn.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. Every request payload, behavior, schema, failure, clock, policy, call/send and storage is unchanged. The generator writes a stale baseCommit literal; it was set by hand to the source commit above. Earlier adopted fixture directories (including failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67) remain byte-identical. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
